decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family close to the core range that survived the initial launch period, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough to retain, and a large firm with broad catalog slack would usually keep such an incremental line unless clear underperformance appears.

This door handle design also fits the established business and has remained visible beyond launch, but as a more design-specific item it is somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning if sales fall below aspiration levels relative to other handle lines.

The electronic access system matches the firm’s strategic move toward integrated digital building solutions, uses its R&D and certified system capabilities, and its differentiated positioning suggests performance likely stays above aspiration, so management would be inclined to continue it.
